title: Short-lag heartbeat magnitude persistence does not establish incremental heart-failure prediction across Holter databases
abstract: Adding non-overlapping lag-two absolute RR-increment correlation to short-window HRV improved the external Brier point estimate by 0.00733, but uncertainty crossed zero (added-minus-baseline -0.00733; joint bootstrap95% [-0.02752, 0.01474]) and penalty sensitivity reversed its direction.
